panels.visual: Plato (broad-shouldered wrestler, neat beard, rich cloak) and two girls in white chitons (red bow and lilac bow) kneeling in the sand in the Academy grove each drawing a circle with a stick, concentrating
panels.caption: Draw me a perfect circle.

panels.visual: Close-up of three wobbly circles drawn in the sand, each a little lumpy, the stick, footprints, a comic sweat drop
panels.caption: Every circle is a little wobbly.

panels.visual: Plato pointing upwards: in the golden sky a perfect shining glowing circle, with a bright halo, the girls gazing up amazed with mouths open
panels.caption: Yet you know exactly what a perfect circle is.

panels.visual: A cave-like picture: prisoners of the cave watching flickering shadows on the wall, while above, a bright shining perfect circle, a triangle and a heart glow in a sunlit opening; Plato's hand pointing
panels.caption: The Forms are above. Everything we see is only a shadow.

speech.speaker: Plato
speech.text: Everything we see is a shadow of the Forms.

panels.visual: Students in the Academy grove with compasses, triangles and diagrams scratched in the sand, a lively geometry lesson
panels.caption: Plato loved geometry.

panels.visual: Plato holding a drawn perfect triangle that glows above his hand, students looking amazed, thought bubble of a shining shape
panels.caption: Perfect shapes you can only think, never touch.

speech.speaker: Plato
speech.text: It trains the mind to see past the shadows.

panels.visual: A sign over the door of a school reading LET NO ONE IGNORANT OF GEOMETRY ENTER, a student reading it with a gulp
panels.caption: A story says a sign over the door read this.

panels.visual: A long shelf of dusty old books with a timeline arrow showing 900 years, a very late writer holding a quill, and Plato with a raised eyebrow
panels.caption: Nobody mentions it until about nine hundred years after he died.
